_comment: PACKAGING (Step5) test config. Header + PO-reconciliation ledger + materials + the POLYBAG~Bale inner-qty calculation. toBeShipped: 'Standalone' (single IPC) or 'Merged' (2+). masterPack is AUTO (STANDARD/ASSORTED) — we do NOT set it, we ASSERT it. packQty maps IPC-code -> qty to pack in the main pack. Materials array = one block per PACKAGING MATERIAL TYPE; keys match the source field names exactly.

packaging._packQty_comment: IPC-code -> how many pcs of it go in the MAIN pack. Leave blank / omit to leave 'Pending'. Use the real IPC codes generated in Step0 for this project (the runner will list them). balance = poQty - packed must reach Nil.
packaging._expectMasterPack_comment: Standalone -> STANDARD, Merged -> ASSORTED. The test asserts the read-only MASTER PACK shows this. 5 IPCs present -> Merged -> ASSORTED.

materials._calc_comment: ★ The one real auto-calc. polybagCount = polybag count input; assdQty maps IPC-code -> ASSD QTY. Test asserts innerQty = casepack/polybagCount and reqMaterial = assd/innerQty (rounded 2dp).
